evidence_kind: Synthetic CPU geometry and frozen future-study configuration only
scope: Initial11760 endpoint requests only, reconstructed from immutable audited-plan and common-home artifacts. Curated after native work began; no native attempts, captures, policies or training results are included.

strict_admission.self_collision: Nonadjacent enabled; only documented mechanical/grasp exclusions

admission_limits.endpoint_scope: Full-pose IK, limits and modeled self/cross-arm/environment/carried-ball clearance only; not ball-flight success or common-home path connectivity.
admission_limits.transit_scope: Common-home clearance is checked at a fixed posture per layout. No selected-shot transit certificates are included in this initial CPU snapshot.
admission_limits.geometry_scope: Proxy convex collision solids; finite sampled paths elsewhere in the protocol are not formal continuous collision proofs or actuator tracking validation.

classification_boundary: Original conservative home categories are preserved verbatim. Zero clearance lower bounds alone do not prove penetration. The separate base-overlap.json supplements two cells with positive-volume modeled hull intersections; it does not rewrite these categories.

reference_joint_hints.provenance: Synthetic stable-shot-0004711 board and previously audited high-park path; rechecked here

common_home.scope: One frozen global joint pair selected once from declared finite family; individually collision-checked in every layout

arms.spacing_provenance: User measured 52.65 inches; base-to-base interpretation assumed

board.mount_status: provisional rigid fixed joint; compliance is NOT calibrated or modeled yet

bucket.height_interpretation: unresolved: overall height or interior depth

dropper.tool_status: geometric two-finger proxy; not a calibrated gripper model

camera.status: synthetic ideal fixed RGB-D; not wrist-camera calibration

simulation.contact_properties_status: uncalibrated; separate from historical numerical models

future_split_scope: Frozen before current native outcomes and disjoint from supplied mjlab source/historical coordinates; grid is DEVELOPMENT then TRAIN; validation/test receive no outcome search here. No claim against every experiment ever run.

excluded_sources: Native shot records, results, logs, queues and checkpoint files
provenance.curation: Aggregate initial audited-plan geometry_eligible/reason fields by the35 contract cells; independently validate contract/common-home fingerprints and selected-plan identity.
